data.long_meaning: A man whose heart is full of joy and happiness. The name Harshil carries the meaning “Happy Heart” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. historical_references.reference: Harshil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Harsh' which means 'joyful' and 'il' meaning 'lofty'. Harshil was a common name during the medieval period in India, particularly among the Rajputs and other warrior classes.

Another reference to Harshil can be found in the 12th century Hindu epic 'Mahabharata', where Harshil is mentioned as the name of a charioteer who drove the chariot of Arjuna, one of the five Pandava brothers, during the great battle of Kurukshetra.
